reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates more targeted hill work and a longer, more structured hill session (55 minutes) which is crucial for trail running strength and efficiency. Plan B focuses almost entirely on easy running, which, while beneficial for building a base, doesn't adequately address the specific demands of trail running like navigating varied terrain and maintaining power uphill. Plan A’s inclusion of a controlled hard effort session (tempo) is also a key differentiator, directly targeting speed development.
